context: Tests whether the craft skill correctly resumes from a partially-completed epic, starting at the first open/ready issue without re-executing closed issues.

checklist.name: Identifies ready tasks
checklist.description: Correctly identifies P3-Write-Tests as the first ready (unblocked, open) task to execute

checklist.name: Starts at correct point
checklist.description: Begins execution at P3 (the first open phase), not at P1 or P2 which are already closed

checklist.name: No re-execution
checklist.description: Does not re-dispatch agents for closed issues (P1, P2-Write-Tests, P2-Implement, P2-Validate)

checklist.name: Continues through phase
checklist.description: Proceeds through P3 issues in dependency order (Write Tests → Implement → Validate)
